topic: What happens if you hold your breath?
title: What holding breath does
hook: What happens if you hold your breath?

beats.label: 10 SECONDS
beats.line: For the first ten seconds or so, holding your breath feels easy.

beats.label: 30 SECONDS
beats.line: By thirty seconds, rising carbon dioxide creates a strong urge to breathe.

beats.label: 60 SECONDS
beats.line: After sixty seconds, your diaphragm can start to spasm and jerk.

beats.label: 90 SECONDS
beats.line: By about ninety seconds, most people already feel a strong urge to gasp.

end.line: Did you hold your breath while watching this?

description: Why the urge to breathe builds so fast when you hold your breath.

facts.claim: Holding your breath causes carbon dioxide to build up, which triggers a strong urge to breathe.
As breath-holding continues, involuntary diaphragm contractions (spasms) can occur.
Most healthy people can comfortably hold their breath for about 30 to 90 seconds.
